sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to services reported using the 1500 Health Insurance Claim Form (a/k/a CMS-1500), UB04 claim form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form. This policy applies to all products, all network and non-network physicians and other qualified health care professionals, outpatient facility claims, Ambulatory Surgical Centers (ASC), Outpatient Surgical Centers (OSC), including, but not limited to, non-network authorized and percent of charge contract physicians, other qualified health care professionals or facilities.

children.title: United Healthcare Commercial
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all UnitedHealthcare Commercial benefit plans.

children.title: UnitedHealthcare Individual Exchange
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all Individual Exchange benefit plans.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for allergen testing.

children.title: In Vitro Serum IgE
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement for the following in vitro serum IgE testing procedure code(s) for individuals 20 years of age or older when billed for any condition other than those listed below. Procedure Code(s) 82785 Condition(s) a. For individuals with moderate to severe asthma. b. For individuals with signs or symptoms of allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis.

children.title: Allergy Testing Limitation
content: UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement for the following specific IgE in vitro allergy testing procedure codes for up to twenty allergen specific antibodies per year for individuals 20 years of age or older.

children.title: Antigen Leukocyte Antibody (ALCAT)
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following antigen leukocyte antibody testing (ALCAT) procedure code(s). Procedure Code(s) 83516

children.title: Immunoglobulins
content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following procedure codes for basophil activation flow cytometry testing and in-vitro testing of IgG, IgA, IgM, and/or IgD when billed for signs or symptoms of allergies.

children.title: Bead-Based Epitope Assays
content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following procedure codes for in vitro allergen testing using bead-based epitope assays.

children.title: Multi-Allergen Screening
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement for the following qualitative specific IgE multi-allergen screen procedure code(s) that do not identify a specific allergen. Procedure Code(s) 86005

content.value: Twenty units per 365 calendar days from initial date of service.

value.Q: Is the frequency limitation based on individual provider per member?
value.A: Frequency limitation is applicable regardless of billing and/or rendering provider (any individual provider OR any facility) for each individual member for the same date of service.

value.Q: Does the frequency limitation of in vitro specific IgE allergy testing apply to each procedure code individually or do all count toward the same limit?
value.A: The frequency limitation applies to each procedure code individually.
